host.description: Host name for the application, like 'wazuh.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

ldap_domain.title: User domain
ldap_domain.description: NS8 user domain used to log in to the dashboard. Empty to disable.

ldap_admin_group.title: Administrators group
ldap_admin_group.description: Group of the user domain that receives the administrator role.

ldap_readonly_group.title: Read-only group
ldap_readonly_group.description: Group of the user domain that can read alerts and agents without changing anything.

index_unclassified_events.title: Keep unclassified logs
index_unclassified_events.description: Index the logs that no decoder recognizes. They take more disk space.

export_url.title: Export URL
export_url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the new findings, as JSON. Empty to disable.

export_token.title: Export token
export_token.description: Optional bearer token sent to the export URL, without spaces or line breaks. Omit to keep the current one, send an empty string to remove it.

admin_password.title: Administrator password
admin_password.description: New password of the dashboard administrator, 12 to 64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . , _ + : @ % ^ = ~ - with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one symbol. Omit it to keep the current one.

retention_days.title: Log retention
retention_days.description: Days the events and findings are kept at least. They are deleted index by index, so a log can stay up to about 30 days more, or a twelfth of the retention when it is longer than a year.

notify_enabled.title: Email notifications
notify_enabled.description: Send a summary of the new findings by email every 5 minutes. Needs the cluster smarthost and at least one recipient.

notify_recipients.title: Email recipients
notify_recipients.description: Addresses that receive a summary of the new findings every 5 minutes. Empty to disable. Needs the cluster smarthost.

notify_sender.title: Email sender
notify_sender.description: Sender address of the emails. Empty means wazuh@ followed by the host name.

notify_min_level.title: Minimum level
notify_min_level.description: Only the findings at this level or above are sent by email.

telegram_enabled.title: Telegram bot
telegram_enabled.description: Send notifications to Telegram at all. Off, no chat gets anything, neither the admin one nor those of the customers. Needs the bot token.

telegram_admin_enabled.title: Telegram admin notifications
telegram_admin_enabled.description: Send the summary of the new findings to the admin chat every 5 minutes, at the same minimum level as the emails. Needs the chat ID.

telegram_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_token.description: Token of the bot that sends every Telegram message of this instance, as given by BotFather. Omit to keep the current one, send an empty string to remove it.

telegram_chat_id.title: Telegram chat ID
telegram_chat_id.description: Admin chat: a group ID like -1001234567890, a user ID, or a public channel like @name. Empty when not used.

ntfy_enabled.title: ntfy notifications
ntfy_enabled.description: Publish the summary of the new findings to an ntfy topic every 5 minutes, at the same minimum level as the emails. Needs the topic.

ntfy_url.title: ntfy server
ntfy_url.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, ntfy.sh or a self-hosted one.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Topic that receives the notifications. Empty when not used.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Access token of an ntfy user allowed to publish to the topic. Omit to keep the current one, send an empty string to remove it. Not needed on a server that lets anybody publish.

mattermost_enabled.title: Mattermost notifications
mattermost_enabled.description: Post the summary of the new findings to a Mattermost incoming webhook every 5 minutes, at the same minimum level as the emails. Needs the webhook.

mattermost_channel.title: Mattermost channel
mattermost_channel.description: Channel name (not the display name) or @user. Empty to post to the channel of the webhook.

mattermost_username.title: Mattermost sender name
mattermost_username.description: Name shown on the posts. Mattermost uses it only with Enable integrations to override usernames. Empty for the name of the webhook.

mattermost_webhook.title: Mattermost incoming webhook
mattermost_webhook.description: URL of the incoming webhook. It is a secret: anybody who knows it can post. Omit to keep the current one, send an empty string to remove it.
